channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Mexico to seek US criminal complaints over ICE-related deaths of citizens
item.description: Claudia Sheinbaum announces Mexico’s strongest response yet to deaths in ICE custody and during immigration enforcement.

item.title: Will NATO get involved in securing Strait of Hormuz?
item.description: Iran war overshadows defence alliance's summit in Turkiye.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz: What has happened since the US-Iran MoU on June 17?
item.description: More than 500 ships have passed through the strait since June 17, but many remain stuck.

item.title: At least 28 people killed as fire engulfs shoe factory in China
item.description: Beijing demands 'all-out' effort to extinguish the blaze, search for survivors and treat the injured.

item.title: Photos: Iran to bury slain supreme leader in culmination of mass funeral
item.description: Iranians gather in sweltering heat for Ayatollah Ali Khamenei’s funeral in his hometown of Mashhad.

item.title: Videos show interception of Iranian missiles in skies over Jordan
item.description: Sirens blared in several cities in Jordan as Iranian missiles were intercepted.

item.title: Tehran launches more strikes after explosions reported in southern Iran
item.description: Centcom says it hit 90 Iranian targets in the latest round of strikes, with the Iranian health ministry saying 14 people were killed since Tuesday.

item.title: Eight killed after landslide hits girls' school in Bangladesh
item.description: Rescuers pull bodies from the mud after heavy monsoon rains batter the south-eastern coast.

item.title: Khamenei's coffin carried through Shia shrines as ceremonies held in Iraq
item.description: The remains of Iran's late supreme leader are transported to Najaf and Karbala, as funeral ceremonies continue for a fifth day.

item.title: Watch: Why is there a 'black cloud' over unity at the Nato summit?
item.description: US President Donald Trump has used the Nato summit to criticise the lack of support for his war on Iran, and revive his interest in taking over Greenland.
